description:
Local OpenAI-compatible router that aggregates free LLM providers.

FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers, plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image, and audio endpoints, behind a single /v1 API.

A router picks the best available model for each request, falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited, and tracks per-key usage so you stay under every free-tier cap. Provider keys are stored encrypted, and the router refreshes its model catalog from a signed feed. Built for personal use only; each provider's terms of service apply.
Zro by MoonMath.ai
- Add your own Zro API key in the Keys dashboard; imports recognize ZRO_API_KEY and MOONMATH_API_KEY.
- OpenAI-compatible normal and streaming chat, tool calls and JSON output use the existing routing and failover behavior.
- Credential validation uses the authenticated model-list endpoint without spending inference tokens.
- Reject mismatched response model identities, credential redirects and in-band streaming errors.
- Account-wide Free usage resets daily; it is not a monthly cash grant. Model availability is managed through the signed catalog rather than bundled seeds.
Catalog compatibility
This release supplies the Zro adapter needed by the November 12 catalog update. The existing Premium-immediate / Free-after-30-days catalog logic is unchanged. Mistral and other providers' application behavior are unchanged.
The catalog publication is separate from the app release. The validated update holds three dated/non-renewing promotions rather than mislabeling them as recurring free, retains stored history, and adds only tested routes.
Local validation: full server/CLI/client suites, locale validation, migration round trips, lint, workspace build and desktop tests. Zro was also tested through the real app router against the Free account with an in-memory database.
